params.model: qwen3-4b-q4km (Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)
params.prewarm: Drafter::prewarm with an app-only hint before begin, as apps/desktop doubletap/flow.rs (connection warm-up; retrieval starts in begin)
params.retrieval: nugget-retrieve text-only (no embedder), default RetrieveConfig, fixed reference time; one in-memory store per persona (draft fixture knowledge items + the persona's sent messages)
params.thinking_pass: 3 drafts, thinking at the model's default
params.timed_from: Drafter::begin (a11y read and IPC not included)
params.voice: persona sent messages: recipient (>= 3 messages) or channel style statistics + 3 exemplars (recipient first, then most recent)

metrics.name: doubletap.ttft.p50
metrics.description: p50 time from Drafter::begin until the provider's first stream event (prompt, retrieval and voice included), over 12 completed drafts

metrics.name: doubletap.ttft.p95
metrics.description: p95 time from Drafter::begin until the provider's first stream event (prompt, retrieval and voice included), over 12 completed drafts

metrics.name: doubletap.first_inserted_token.p50
metrics.description: p50 time from Drafter::begin until the first post-processed text the overlay shows and the user can insert (insertion itself not timed); drafts with no visible text excluded, over 12 completed drafts

metrics.name: doubletap.first_inserted_token.p95
metrics.description: p95 time from Drafter::begin until the first post-processed text the overlay shows and the user can insert (insertion itself not timed); drafts with no visible text excluded, over 12 completed drafts

metrics.name: doubletap.total.p50
metrics.description: p50 time from Drafter::begin until the draft stream finished, over 12 completed drafts

metrics.name: doubletap.total.p95
metrics.description: p95 time from Drafter::begin until the draft stream finished, over 12 completed drafts

metrics.name: doubletap.retrieval.p50
metrics.description: Median time Drafter::begin waited for retrieval and the voice lookup

metrics.name: doubletap.requests
metrics.description: Timed drafts attempted

metrics.name: doubletap.completed
metrics.description: Drafts whose stream finished

metrics.name: doubletap.failures
metrics.description: Drafts that failed (begin refused or errored, or the stream errored)

metrics.name: doubletap.timeouts
metrics.description: Drafts that took longer than 180 s end to end (cancelled)

metrics.name: doubletap.empty_drafts
metrics.description: Completed drafts with no visible text

metrics.name: doubletap.retrieval_skipped
metrics.description: Completed drafts whose retrieval timed out or failed (drafted without context)

metrics.name: doubletap.output_tokens_per_s
metrics.description: Provider-reported output tokens over the time from the first insertable token to the end of the stream (drafts with usage only)

metrics.name: doubletap.prompt_tokens.mean
metrics.description: Mean provider-reported prompt tokens (12 drafts with usage)

metrics.name: doubletap.cold.first_inserted_token
metrics.description: Warm-up draft (first after model start, not in the percentiles): time to the first insertable token

metrics.name: doubletap.cold.ttft
metrics.description: Warm-up draft (first after model start, not in the percentiles): time to the provider's first event

metrics.name: doubletap.cold.total
metrics.description: Warm-up draft (first after model start, not in the percentiles): time to the end of the stream

metrics.name: doubletap.thinking_model_default.ttft.p50
metrics.description: Thinking left at the model's default (Qwen3: thinks first): median ttft over 3 completed drafts

metrics.name: doubletap.thinking_model_default.total.p50
metrics.description: Thinking left at the model's default (Qwen3: thinks first): median total over 3 completed drafts

metrics.name: doubletap.thinking_model_default.requests
metrics.description: Thinking at the model's default: Drafts attempted

metrics.name: doubletap.thinking_model_default.empty_drafts
metrics.description: Thinking at the model's default: Completed drafts with no visible text (the output budget went to thinking)

metrics.name: doubletap.thinking_model_default.failures
metrics.description: Thinking at the model's default: Drafts that failed

metrics.name: doubletap.thinking_model_default.timeouts
metrics.description: Thinking at the model's default: Drafts that timed out
